First release of Stellar PDF - a native Linux PDF editor. No Adobe required.

## Features

- **AcroForm fill** - interactive inputs positioned over real PDF form fields (text, checkbox, radio, dropdown)
- **Visual field detection** - detects drawn boxes and underlines on flat PDFs
- **Permanent redaction** - content is burned out of the file, not just covered
- **Text insertion** - click anywhere, type, Enter to commit
- **Undo** - up to 20 levels of in-memory snapshots (Ctrl+Z)
- **Page navigation** - thumbnail sidebar, prev/next, arrow keys
- **Zoom** - 50% to 300%
- **Dark theme**

## Packages

| Format | Distro |
|--------|--------|
| `.AppImage` | Universal Linux |
| `.deb` | Ubuntu / Debian |
| `.rpm` | Fedora / RHEL |

## Requirements

- Linux x64
- For AppImage: no installation needed, just `chmod +x` and run
- For deb/rpm: standard package manager install

## Stack

Electron 33 + PDF.js 4 (rendering) + PyMuPDF (all write operations via JSON RPC).
